eventDetail.scope: CIR 2026 focuses on advancing research and global collaboration in computational intelligence and robotics. The conference highlights progress in core algorithms, intelligent optimization, deep learning, natural language processing, and computer vision, while addressing the latest achievements in robotics, including perception, motion planning, human–robot interaction, service robotics, and industrial automation. By fostering interdisciplinary exchange and international cooperation, CIR 2026 aims to drive innovative applications, tackle real-world challenges, and shape the future of smart technologies.
